items.docs: Lists the available changefeed RCU options that can be selected for a changefeed.

params.name: clusterId
params.description: The ID of the cluster to list changefeeds for.

params.name: downstreamType
params.description: The downstream type to filter by. When not specified, returns all types.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The maximum number of changefeeds to return. The default value is 20.

params.name: pageToken
params.description: The page token from a previous ListChangefeeds response, used to retrieve the next page.

items.docs: Lists the changefeeds for a cluster. Results can be filtered by downstream type and paginated using the page token.
Creates a changefeed to replicate data from a TiDB cluster to a downstream system. Supports Kafka, MySQL, S3, GCS, and Azure Blob downstream types.

params.name: changefeedId
params.description: The ID of the changefeed to retrieve.

params.name: invalidateCache
params.description: Indicates whether to bypass the cache and return the real-time checkpoint information.

items.docs: Gets the details of a changefeed by its ID, including its state, configuration, and checkpoint information.

params.name: changefeedId
params.description: The ID of the changefeed to delete.

items.docs: Deletes a changefeed by its ID. This operation cannot be undone. The changefeed must be in a deletable state.

params.name: changefeedId
params.description: The ID of the changefeed to update.

items.docs: Updates the mutable configuration of an existing changefeed. The changefeed must be in the PAUSED state.

params.name: changefeedId
params.description: The ID of the changefeed to pause.

items.docs: Pauses a running changefeed. While paused, the changefeed stops replicating data but retains its configuration and checkpoint.

params.name: changefeedId
params.description: The ID of the changefeed to resume.

items.docs: Resumes a paused changefeed. The changefeed continues replicating data from its last checkpoint.

params.name: changefeedId
params.description: The ID of the changefeed to scale.

items.docs: Scales a changefeed to a different replication capacity (RCU). The new capacity takes effect after the operation completes.
